messages:
Maya (Design): Heads-up — quick review of the API keys modal iteration. Focus: create/rotate flows + empty state CTAs.
Kevin (PM): TL;DR — two UX issues reported by support: 1) reveal secret affordance confusing, 2) revoke/rotate warnings aren't explicit about side effects.
Sofia (Frontend): I can prototype fixes after we lock copy & focus order. Current DOM order is: name -> scopes -> buttons. That causes screen readers to hit action buttons before the key label.
Oliver (A11y): That ordering is problematic. Suggest moving the key label (and the copy-to-clipboard) earlier, then the reveal button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` properly set. Also ensure reveal has descriptive aria-label like: "Show API secret for <key name> — only visible now".
Maya (Design): Agreed. Copy proposal for reveal aria-label: "Show key secret (temporary)". For screen-visible label: small helper copy: "This secret is only shown once. Save it now or rotate later." Thoughts?
Jamal (Support): +1 on the helper text. We keep seeing users click rotate immediately then open tickets saying integrations broke. We should add inline sentence in rotate modal: "Rotating will invalidate any clients using this secret — update integrations before rotating." Maybe a bold line.
Kevin (PM): Let's make rotate modal two-step: modal 1 explains impact with bullet list, CTA "Proceed to rotate"; modal 2 shows new secret once generated. This reduces accidental rotates.
Sofia (Frontend): Two-step is doable. Suggest we also add a small checkbox "I understand this will break active integrations" to surface intent and allow analytics on accidental rotates.
Oliver (A11y): Checkbox needs accessible label and keyboard focus order before the final CTA. Please ensure for keyboard users the checkbox is reachable by tab before the rotate button.
Maya (Design): Empty state CTA in keys list: current label "Create API Key" is generic. Support asked for more context. Options: "Create a key for your app" vs "Create a key — used by services and scripts". Preference?
Jamal (Support): Use contextual label dependent on user role. For normal users: "Create API key for development"; for org admins: "Create production API key". Even if we don't implement role-specific labels now, adding secondary microcopy under the CTA could help.
Kevin (PM): For rollout, let's A/B test: variant A keep current, variant B add helper line and more explicit rotate flow. Track rotate->support tickets for 30d.
Sofia (Frontend): I'll sketch markup and ensure reveal button has aria-pressed when toggled and persists focus. Also will add `aria-live` region for copy-to-clipboard success.
Maya (Design): I'll update the mockups and two short copy options for legal review. Small nit: use sentence case on helper copy and avoid passive voice.
deploy-bot: new deploy queued: frontend/keys-modal-prototype @staging
Kevin (PM): Thanks team. Action items: Maya — updated mocks by EOD; Sofia — prototype keyboard flow & `aria-*` by Thurs; Oliver — quick a11y checklist; Jamal — collect recent rotate support threads for examples. We'll reconvene Fri 10am. :thumbsup:
